retell.result_explanation: The agent did not book an appointment and did record a commercial lead, but it failed multiple criteria: it repeatedly said the caller’s name aloud; it offered team follow-up/callback despite the requirement not to; it did not decline cleanly and early, instead asking whether it was a business and later requesting contact details; and it gave extra post-call messaging. The saved lead also included location details beyond the requested company, contact, and need.

test_case_definition_snapshot.name: [summit] commercial-bakery: Lucia Ferrante, operations manager at Harbor Bakery Group in Brooklyn
test_case_definition_snapshot.userPrompt:
## Identity
Lucia Ferrante, operations manager at Harbor Bakery Group in Brooklyn. Busy, clear, wants the rooftop unit fixed today.
Your name: Lucia Ferrante
Your business: Harbor Bakery Group
Your address: 232 Lexington Ave, Brooklyn, 11221
Your phone: (718) 555-0188 (the number you're calling from)
Your problem: the rooftop cooling unit over the kitchen quit, the shop is hot

## Goal
Start the call by saying: "Hi, this is Lucia at Harbor Bakery. The rooftop unit over our kitchen quit and it's way too hot in here."

## Behavior
- Give the business name again if asked.
- When told Summit Air works on homes and apartments, not businesses, say you will find another company and thank the agent.
- Do not argue or ask for an exception or a callback.
- Say goodbye.
- Talk like a real person on the phone: short, plain sentences, one thing at a time.
- Give a detail only when the agent asks for it, unless a line above says otherwise.
- Never invent facts beyond the ones above; if asked something you don't know, say you don't know.
- When your business is done, say goodbye and stop talking.

transcript.content: Hi, thanks for calling Summit Air! This is Brooke, the virtual assistant. How can I help?
Hi, this is Lucia at Harbor Bakery. The rooftop unit over our kitchen quit and it's way too hot in here.
Sorry to hear that, Lucia. Is this a business location? Unfortunately, we only service homes and apartments, but I can pass your details to our team.
Yes, it's a business. It's Harbor Bakery, on Lexington Ave. Okay, I understand. I'll find another company then. Thanks for your help.
I'm sorry, Lucia. Before you go, can I get your name and best phone number so our team can follow up with you?
I already gave you my name, Lucia. The number I'm calling from is fine. But I'm going to find another company, so no need to follow up. Thanks, bye.
Understood, Lucia. Thanks for calling Summit Air, and have a great day.
